functions.name: mod_kahoodle_create_modules

modules.desc: Kahoodle activities to create. Add the questions afterwards with mod_kahoodle_create_questions.

section.desc: Section number in the course (0 is the top section).

intro.desc: Description of the activity (HTML). Files from introdraftitemid can be embedded as @@PLUGINFILE@@/filename.ext.

introformat.desc: Format of intro: 1 = HTML, 0 = Moodle auto-format, 2 = plain text, 4 = Markdown.

introdraftitemid.desc: Draft file area id with the files embedded in intro.

visible.desc: Availability: 1 = shown on the course page, 0 = hidden, -1 = available but not shown on the course page (if the site allows it).

lang.desc: Language to force for the activity, for example "de". Empty for no forced language.

questionformat.desc: How question text is written: 0 = plain text, at most 300 characters, with an optional image shown under it; 1 = rich text (HTML) with embedded images.

identitymode.desc: How participants appear on the leaderboard: 0 = real name, 1 = real name or an alias they choose, 2 = an alias they must choose, 3 = fully anonymous.

allowrepeat.desc: Whether a user may take part in more than one round: 1 = yes, 0 = no.

lobbyduration.desc: Seconds the lobby stays open for participants to join before the first question.

questionpreviewduration.desc: Default seconds a question is shown before answers open.

questionduration.desc: Default seconds participants have to answer a question.

questionresultsduration.desc: Default seconds the results of a question are shown.

maxpoints.desc: Default points for the fastest correct answer.

minpoints.desc: Default points for the slowest correct answer.

index.desc: Index of the activity in the modules parameter

cmid.desc: Course module id of the new activity

kahoodleid.desc: Kahoodle instance id of the new activity

warningcode.desc: the warning code can be used by the client app to implement specific behaviour

message.desc: untranslated english message to explain the warning

functions.description: Create (add) one or more Kahoodle activities, live classroom quiz games, in a course. Add their questions afterwards with mod_kahoodle_create_questions.

functions.name: mod_kahoodle_create_questions

cmid.desc: Course module id of the Kahoodle activity

questiontype.desc: Question type, one of: multichoice. Default: multichoice.

questiontext.desc: Question text. In plain text format (the activity's questionformat 0) it is at most 300 characters. In rich text format (1) it is HTML whose main question is in an <h3> tag, and it can embed files from imagedraftitemid as @@PLUGINFILE@@/filename.ext.

questionconfig.desc:
Type-specific configuration. Its format depends on the question type:
- multichoice: the answers, one per line, 2 to 8 of them; put * before the one correct answer, for example "Paris\n*Rome\nMadrid". Once participants have answered the question, the number of answers and which one is correct cannot change.

imagedraftitemid.desc: Draft file area id with images: in plain text format one image shown under the text, in rich text format the files embedded in questiontext.

questionpreviewduration.desc: Seconds the question is shown before answers open. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to use the activity default.

questionduration.desc: Seconds participants have to answer. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to use the activity default.

questionresultsduration.desc: Seconds the results of the question are shown. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to use the activity default.

maxpoints.desc: Points for the fastest correct answer. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to use the activity default.

minpoints.desc: Points for the slowest correct answer. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to use the activity default.

position.desc: Position (1-based) of the first new question in the round; the others follow it. 0 adds them at the end.

index.desc: Index of the question in the questions parameter

warningcode.desc: the warning code can be used by the client app to implement specific behaviour

message.desc: untranslated english message to explain the warning

functions.name: mod_kahoodle_update_question

questionid.desc: Question id, from mod_kahoodle_get_questions. Pass only the fields that change; the others stay.

questiontext.desc: New question text, in the same format as in mod_kahoodle_create_questions.

questionconfig.desc:
Type-specific configuration. Its format depends on the question type:
- multichoice: the answers, one per line, 2 to 8 of them; put * before the one correct answer, for example "Paris\n*Rome\nMadrid". Once participants have answered the question, the number of answers and which one is correct cannot change.

imagedraftitemid.desc: Draft file area id with the images that replace the current ones.

questionpreviewduration.desc: Seconds the question is shown before answers open. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to keep the current value.

questionduration.desc: Seconds participants have to answer. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to keep the current value.

questionresultsduration.desc: Seconds the results of the question are shown. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to keep the current value.

maxpoints.desc: Points for the fastest correct answer. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to keep the current value.

minpoints.desc: Points for the slowest correct answer. 0 uses the activity default. Omit to keep the current value.

position.desc: New position (1-based) of the question in the round. Only before the round starts.
